name: SQ8LMPC
author: L'Cronx
summary: SQ8L 0.91b (Ensoniq SQ-80 emulation by Siegfried Kullmann, based on sq8l-revival) on the Akai Force: same engine and sound, the SQ8L panel on one screen, 128 factory sounds, your own banks with SAVE, drop-in banks. Bring your own SQ-80 wave ROM (not included). Unofficial, free, non-commercial.
